# DEV Community

> > A vibrant discussion forum and content platform for software developers to share knowledge, collaborate, and grow their careers across web development, AI, open source, and modern programming technologies.

DEV Community is a collaborative platform where developers publish articles, tutorials, and discussion posts on topics ranging from web development and JavaScript frameworks to AI/ML, DevOps, and career guidance. The community emphasizes accessibility for beginners while supporting experienced developers with in-depth technical content.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- React
- TypeScript
- Web Development
- Artificial Intelligence
- Open Source
- DevOps
- Python
- Security
- Career Development
- Developer Tools
- Frontend Frameworks
- CI/CD
- Community Platform
- Programming Tutorials

## Core Platform

- [DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net): DEV Community homepage: discussion forum for software development
- [Welcome! - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net/enter): DEV Community sign-up and authentication page with OAuth options

## Programming Languages & Frameworks

- [JavaScript - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net/t/javascript): JavaScript and frontend framework community posts and tutorials
- [React - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net/t/react): React and Next.js development posts with TypeScript and AI integration
- [Python - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net/t/python): Python programming tutorials and AI/machine learning discussions
- [Web Development - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net/t/webdev): Web development community posts on JavaScript frameworks and AI

## Learning & Tutorials

- [Beginners - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net/t/beginners): Beginner guides for web development, JavaScript, and programming
- [Tutorial - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net/t/tutorial): Tutorials on PostgreSQL, algorithms, Go, and open-source projects

## Specialized Topics

- [Artificial Intelligence - DEV Community](https://practicaldev-herokuapp-com.global.ssl.fastly.net/t/ai): AI and machine learning community posts and discussions

## Community & Career
